fieldValues.title: Packages
fieldValues.summary: A package adds kinds of record to your essay. Document > Packages… lists the published ones and what each is for. Install adds one with anything it needs, and you can use it straight away.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: When the essay needs a kind of record it doesn't have, call ui_packages. If a published package has it, tell the writer why, then call ui_request_package. The writer confirms on screen; you can't install it yourself. Call ui_packages to see how it ended. Don't offer a package the writer has no use for.
